modelAccess.deepseekKeyPlaceholder: Paste your copied DeepSeek API key
modelAccess.checked: Prices and entry points checked on 2026-10-02; current provider pages take precedence.
modelAccess.sharing: Cloud services receive relevant content; keys are stored on this computer.
modelAccess.deepseekRecommendation: Recommended for study: official DeepSeek Flash (paid).
modelAccess.deepseekCost: Example answer: about CNY 0.02–0.04; billed by actual usage.
modelAccess.deepseekGuide: How to get an API key: step-by-step guide and costs
modelAccess.deepseekIntro: An API key connects Weave to your service account. Get it in your browser, then paste it here. A DeepSeek chat login does not provide an API balance. No extra software is needed.
modelAccess.deepseekStep1Body: Open the link below in a new tab. Keep Weave open so you can return to this form.
modelAccess.deepseekStep2Title: Sign in with your phone number
modelAccess.deepseekStep2Body: Enter your number, click Send verification code, enter the SMS code, read the terms, and sign in if you agree. New numbers are registered automatically. Existing users may use password or WeChat login. Do not enter your password or verification code in Weave.
modelAccess.deepseekStep3Title: Check your balance before topping up
modelAccess.deepseekStep3Body: Check Usage or your account balance. API calls are paid; available promotional credit is used first. Calls fail without available credit. If needed, choose a small amount allowed by the platform and complete payment yourself. Weave does not charge for model services or top up your account.
modelAccess.deepseekStep4Body: Choose API keys in the platform sidebar or use the link below. If redirected to sign-in, sign in and reopen the link.
modelAccess.deepseekStep5Body: Click Create API key. If asked for a name, enter Weave study and confirm. This is a label for the key, not a model name.
modelAccess.deepseekStep6Body: Use the copy button in the creation result. Do not copy masked text from the key list. If you can no longer view the full value, create a new key. Keep keys out of chats and note content.
modelAccess.deepseekStep7Title: Return to Weave and select DeepSeek
modelAccess.deepseekStep7Body: Open Settings → Model → Add model service. Choose DeepSeek in Provider and paste the copied key into API Key. New forms select this service by default.
modelAccess.deepseekStep8Body: Keep deepseek-flash in Model name, or fetch models and select it. This is the current official Flash ID. The URL is filled as https://api.deepseek.com/v1. Leave advanced settings at their defaults.
modelAccess.deepseekStep9Body: Click Test connection. After a successful result, click Save model configuration. The test sends a short question with no knowledge content and uses a small amount of billable usage. Testing alone does not save the form.
modelAccess.deepseekStep10Title: Import study material and ask a question
modelAccess.deepseekStep10Body: Open Knowledge → Import sources, select a small note or paste text, review and confirm the changes. Then start a new chat and ask, for example, what the key points are. Check usage and balance on the DeepSeek platform.
modelAccess.deepseekTroubleshooting: For an invalid key, copy the full value again. For insufficient balance, check credit on the official platform. For unavailable models, fetch the model list again. Retry later if busy. If buttons change, consult the official instructions below.
modelAccess.deepseekBilling: Example main answer: 10,000 input tokens and 2,000 output tokens, with no input cache hits, costs CNY 0.018 off-peak or 0.036 at peak, rounded to 0.02–0.04. Tokens are billing units, not characters; output includes billed thinking content. Input includes source context and chat history. Title generation, conversation summaries and source processing are extra calls; longer inputs or answers cost more. This is an example, not a fixed price or cap. Current per-million rates: input CNY 1/2 and output CNY 4/8 (off-peak/peak). Cache hits are cheaper.
modelAccess.siliconflowRecommendation: Recommended for source lookup: SiliconFlow (the two selected models are currently free).
modelAccess.siliconflowCost: BAAI/bge-m3 and BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 are free; Pro versions are paid. Identity verification is required.
modelAccess.siliconflowGuide: Get a SiliconFlow API key: step-by-step guide
modelAccess.siliconflowIntro: This optional service finds sources with similar meanings and ranks relevant results. It uses a separate key from the answer model. Local text lookup works without it. One SiliconFlow key can serve both lookup models.
modelAccess.siliconflowStep1Body: Open the link below, use the offered phone or email sign-in, and enter the verification code. First-time users should follow registration prompts and read the terms before choosing to continue. Keep Weave open.
modelAccess.siliconflowStep2Body: Follow the platform identity-verification prompt and choose personal verification. If no prompt appears, look for identity verification in the account menu. Verification is currently required for service access. Submit identity details only on the official platform, not to Weave. See the official instructions below.
modelAccess.siliconflowStep3Body: Choose API Keys in the sidebar or follow the link below. If sign-in is required, sign in and reopen it.
modelAccess.siliconflowStep4Body: Click Create API Key, enter Weave source lookup as the description and confirm. Copy the full value. Keep the page open until you have pasted it into Weave.
modelAccess.siliconflowStep5Title: Return to Source lookup in Weave
modelAccess.siliconflowStep5Body: Open Settings → Source lookup → Configure source lookup. Paste the key into Source lookup API key. DeepSeek and SiliconFlow keys are not interchangeable.
modelAccess.siliconflowStep6Title: Check the URL and the two free model names
modelAccess.siliconflowStep6Body: Use https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1, BAAI/bge-m3 for semantic lookup, and BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 for relevance ranking. These defaults are already filled for first-time setup. Keep capitalization and slashes unchanged and do not add Pro/.
modelAccess.siliconflowStep7Body: Turn on Find sources by meaning, leave other values at their defaults, and click Save lookup configuration. Wait for the saved confirmation.
modelAccess.siliconflowStep8Title: Check connection and wait for preparation
modelAccess.siliconflowStep8Body: Click Test lookup connection and look for Semantic lookup and relevance filtering services are connected. After saving, Weave prepares lookup data in the background. When the prepared count reaches the total, it is ready. If preparation fails, check the key, identity verification and model names, then click Update lookup data to continue. Completed work is preserved.
modelAccess.siliconflowStep9Title: Check the free versions and ask a question
modelAccess.siliconflowStep9Body: Search the exact model names in Models on SiliconFlow and check that they are marked free, or consult official pricing below. Start a new chat in Weave; configured lookup is used automatically. Free models still have rate limits; retry later if busy.
modelAccess.siliconflowTroubleshooting: For permission errors, complete identity verification on the platform. For invalid keys, copy the full value again. For rate limits, retry later. Check pricing and access before choosing other models.
modelAccess.siliconflowBilling: The two recommended non-Pro models currently cost zero per call and do not depend on promotional credit. Their Pro/ variants each currently cost CNY 0.07 per million tokens; other models have their own prices. Free lookup does not make DeepSeek answers free. With paid lookup models, preparing the initial knowledge base also consumes usage.
